description: This file defines the Aws\Rds\\RdsClient class, a client for interacting with Amazon RDS via the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method declarations for various RDS operations, presigning middleware setup in the constructor, and internal methods for applying documentation filters to API models.

classes.name: RdsClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon RDS interactions, extending AwsClient, with methods for RDS operations, middleware setup, and internal documentation filter application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the RdsClient, setting up presigning middleware for specific operations.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Internal static method to apply documentation filters and augment API shape definitions for specific parameters like SourceRegion and DestinationRegion.
